cohort: 57,354 deliveries occurring from 2016-2022 at a women's specialty hospital in a southern state of the United States
finding: Women who conceived with medically assisted fertility treatments were at increased risk of cesarean deliveries, gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, delivery complications, and postpartum readmission.
mod_finding: Compared to unassisted pregnancies, MAR was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, while IVF was associated with an increased risk of both cesarean delivery and delivery complications.
